geometry.semicircle_base_pose: arc down, straight edge above; high-valence target

volume_envelope.method: causal Hann smoothing of finite peak release
volume_envelope.continuity: continuous radius and rate; no positive-radius cutoff

geometry.orientation: instrument base pose plus valence rotation

rotation.transition: interpolate target angles over the full current bar; no anticipation

geometry.area: all outer shapes have area pi * volume_radius^2; centered at area centroid
geometry.mean_statistics: retained for inspection only; no effect on shape identity

material.seed: fixed per instrument; object-local pattern; static background
material.overlap: apply material over predicted mixed-audio color

drums_outline.tiny_shape: compress both widths and gap inside silhouette

geometry.outline_formula: outline_arousal_scale * outline_multipliers[stem] * raw_arousal * viewport_height / 540; inset, capped to inradius
geometry.transition: instrument family stays fixed; border and rotation interpolate over full current bar; no early shift

transition.duration_formula: receiving_interval*(1-expm1(strength*novelty)/expm1(strength)); capped by configured fraction of receiving interval
transition.novelty_measurement: time-weighted mean or peak Foote in boundary window, clipped to 0..1
transition.timing: start exactly at original next segment start; never show next color before boundary
transition.missing_foote: use interval between original segment starts, subject only to configured percentage
transition.maximum_novelty: zero duration means an instantaneous color change

mapping.hue: atan2(sum(weight*sin(h)), sum(weight*cos(h))) modulo 360; all valid mapped scores participate; weight=score**hue_gamma; zero scores contribute zero
mapping.hue_fallback: only when all weights are zero: highest valid score among the nine mapped tags; ties use tag_hues_degrees order; unit weight even when score is zero
mapping.gamma_convention: output=input**gamma; hue gamma modifies weights, not hue angles

sv_adaptation.order: normalize -> adaptive blend -> normalized sigmoid -> gamma -> output range

mapping.undefined_hue: no mapped color when no valid mapped tags exist or circular vectors cancel

beat_motion.mean: duration-weighted mean of existing frame centroid over active audio in each original beat
beat_motion.silence: exclude quiet frames from means and min/max; hold last position in silent beats
beat_motion.transition: previous beat mean to current beat mean over entire current beat; no anticipation

pitch.beat_statistic: median of accepted MIDI frames whose centers lie in the original beat
pitch.invalid: exclude below engine-specific confidence threshold, unvoiced, nonfinite and quiet frames; hold last position; start centered
pitch.transition: beat: full-current-beat smoothstep; continuous: causal MIDI exponential response; no lookahead targets

overlap.region_rule: exact set of intersecting instrument silhouettes, clipped to viewport
overlap.audio_rule: sample-aligned original-gain sum, no score/color averaging
overlap.missing_color: ordinary layered fill, visible missing predictions reported
overlap.outline_rule: all enabled instrument borders painted last

movement.x: full current bar: previous arousal position to current arousal position
movement.y: non-drums: accepted MIDI pitch, beat median or continuous; drums: beat mean centroid
movement.foote_motion_rule: quintic easing of normalized Foote integral; continuous pitch uses integrated Foote followed by causal 60ms Hann smoothing
movement.velocity_continuity: C1 across anchors, pitch frames, loss of voicing, percentile limits and terminal braking
